Author: Sith
Name: Nisi Assist
Description:
Overlay for The Epic of Alexander (Ultimate), Brute Justice / Cruise Chaser phase.
Shows, for the 3rd and 4th Nisi pass, which Nisi to pass or collect, who to swap with,
a countdown for the pass window, and the remaining time on your own Nisi.
Logic and timings are derived from the Cactbot TEA triggers/timeline.
Punchline: TEA phase 2: tells you who to swap Judgment Nisi with on passes 3 and 4.
